text:
maria (eng-platform): Quick sync — EU aggregate recompute backlog spiked after the mesh ingest burst. Current queue ~22k slices. We need a short plan: fractional reslice, quota bump, or swap priority lanes?
kevin (eng-sre): Ugh. Observed high CPU on replayer nodes. Throttling at 60% is holding but slow.
yu (eng-platform): What's the SLA impact? Any dashboard alerts firing?
sophia (product): Dashboard freshness alerts started for session-agg at +6h, customers seeing stale billing metrics :grimacing:
eli (eng-platform): Can we do a fractional reslice to process hot tenants first? e.g., take top 15% of slices by event-rate and run them with higher concurrency.
kevin (eng-sre): Fractional sounds good. Need to ensure lease tokens don't blow up. Also quota checks for reserved slots.
dan (eng-runtime): I can add a route policy to prefer dedicated replayer pool for high-q slices. But routing policy tweak needs API change (accepts slice_priority tag) — small change though.
yu (eng-platform): We discussed API tag earlier. Debate was whether to add `priority_hint` to /replay API. If we do that, console can surface a toggle.
eli (eng-platform): Proposal: 1) run fractional reslice (0.15) that selects top-slice by ingestion rate; 2) temporary quota bump for dedicated pool to +25% for 2 hours; 3) canary routing via `priority_hint` to dedicated pool; 4) monitor cost and TTL.
maria (eng-platform): Sounds good. Who owns the fractional selector? Is it a scheduler change or a query in the console preflight?
eli (eng-platform): I can push a small change to scheduler (selector) + add a flag `--fractional-top` for ops. Example CLI:
```
replayctl start --dataset=europe-agg --fractional-top=0.15 --concurrency=80 --canary=true
```
kevin (eng-sre): Before we run, add a safety cap on token leases: `max_lease=300s` and a hard stop if error-rate > 1%.
dan (eng-runtime): Agree. Also add fallback routing: if dedicated pool rejects, route to best-effort pool with lower concurrency.
yu (eng-platform): UI/Console side: add a preflight panel that shows estimated slices, estimated cost, and affected tenants. Minimal change: compute preview in backend and show summary in modal.
sophia (product): Product ok with small modal. Need a "customer impact" note for any tenants with SLOs.
kevin (eng-sre): Ops checklist: backup current queue, snapshot current worker state, enable debug logging for first 5 slices.
eli (eng-platform): I'll open a PR for `--fractional-top` in scheduler and a tiny API patch for `priority_hint`. Target: patch + deploy in next 3h if tests pass.
maria (eng-platform): Good. Can someone run a dry-run preview and paste numbers?
backfill-bot: preview ready — selected 3,320 slices (15% of 22,134), est tokens: 4.2M, est runtime: ~45m with concurrency=80.
kevin (eng-sre): Preview numbers look sane. Cost delta ~+12% for the burst window.
sophia (product): Approve — communicate to affected customers via status page if we hit >30m degradation.
dan (eng-runtime): I'll wire the fallback route and the token cap. ETA 40m.
yu (eng-platform): I'll add the console modal and the API flag. ETA 2h.
eli (eng-platform): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/replay/pull/712 — implements selector + CLI. Please review.
maria (eng-platform): Thanks. Post updates here as you progress. Keep alerts on. :eyes:
kevin (eng-sre): Will monitor. If error-rate > 0.8% we abort and revert routing immediately.
eli (eng-platform): Starting canary in 10m, will post logs.
maria (eng-platform): 👍
